description:
Migrate `Components.AssistantMessage.TextBlock`,
`Components.AssistantMessage.ThinkingBlock`, and
`Components.CompactionSummaryMessage` to the VDom contract.

These are streaming-aware: today they implement the `update/2` +
`finalize/2` callbacks. Under VDom, those become hook-cell snapshots
managed by the reconciler — the component function reads the
current snapshot from `use_state`/dedicated streaming hook and emits
a VFlow of VText.

Acceptance: structs and `@behaviour OctoPi.TUI.Component` callbacks
deleted; existing transcript_test.exs assertions stay green;
streaming smoke test in tmux shows tokens append at the same
cadence.
title: Convert AssistantMessage blocks + CompactionSummaryMessage
